failed_packaging_checks.name: macOS Apple silicon DMG
failed_packaging_checks.failed_step: Verify packaged MCP without GUI initialization

diagnosis.observed: Both fresh second desktops panicked before publishing the close receipt: Surface is not configured for presentation.
diagnosis.source_cause: wgpu 30.0.1 requires an empty GPU queue during surface configuration and reports GpuWaitTimeout if another thread submits while it waits. The independent CAD worker submits to the same queue. Bevy stores configuration errors in its device error handler, then attempts acquisition before handling that error on the next extraction.
diagnosis.proof_limit: The configuration race is inferred from the retained native panic and pinned dependency source; the original release stderr does not retain the prior configuration diagnostic.
diagnosis.repair: Share an owned queue lease across interface surface/asset preparation and worker asset/draw submissions. Protect outdated-surface reconfiguration as well as startup/resize. Release before CAD shader compilation and on render-world teardown.
diagnosis.shutdown_dependency: A final pipelined UI frame can retain the queue lease while its surface task awaits the main thread. Worker teardown services that executor while waiting for CAD exit, preventing a cyclic wait.

rendered_gpu_evidence.observed: Menu text remains visible before viewport compilation, and the completed native box texture composites into the interface.

rebase.tested_renderer_source_unchanged: The original queue repair was byte-identical after rebase. A subsequent tested change services main-thread render tasks at worker teardown.

limits: The local GPU fixture uses a windowless native adapter; actual packaged window lifecycle is verified by CI.
No broad UI/MCP qualification or packaged appearance acceptance is claimed.
retained_pass_policy: The earlier native Measure and windowless GPU passes are retained. Only the queue schedule/teardown checks and strict desktop check were repeated for the actual shutdown dependency added after the initial queue fix.
